floor_mentions.reason: The notation Prop and formula formation are ambient in the propositional language root.

not_dependencies.reason: The variable set is syntactic and does not assign truth values.
No semantic satisfaction relation is needed to state the set of variables occurring in a formula.

statement_assertions: The variable set Var(phi) is recursively defined.
For an atomic variable P, Var(phi) is the singleton set {P}.
Negation preserves the variable set of its subformula.
A binary connective formula has variable set equal to the union of the variable sets of its two subformulas.
statement_conditions: If phi is a propositional variable P in Prop.
If phi has the form neg psi.
If phi has the form psi circ chi.

statement_dependency_concepts.reason: The variable-set operation is defined on formulas.
The base case and codomain of the variable set use propositional variables.
The recursive cases use negation and binary connective formation.
The binary connective case defines Var(phi) using union of two variable sets.
The definition is explicitly recursive over formula formation cases.
